issues.description: The template implementation of PersonResource.createPerson declares and returns a ResponseEntity<Person> (providing the created entity in the response), but the solution implementation changes the method to return void and only calls personService.save(person). This is a return-type/signature mismatch between template and solution that can confuse students comparing their starter code with the reference solution and when deciding how to implement or test the endpoint.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the createPerson method signature consistent across template and solution. Either change the solution implementation to return ResponseEntity<Person> and return ResponseEntity.ok(savedPerson) (preferred to match the template and explicitly return the created entity), or change the template to use void as in the solution and document that the endpoint returns an empty 200 OK. Update any example tests or documentation accordingly so students are not confused by differing signatures.
